findings.title: Qualified requests can enter analysis without retained inputs
findings.mechanism: Request accepts qualified=true and retained=false. analyze has no guard for that combination. inspect_subject omits semantic and runtime reasons for TypeScript under retained=false, while batch::profile still emits modelo-suite-static-v1. A simple exported TypeScript function with no other reason can therefore become analyzed under the qualified profile although the baseline refuses this mode before extraction.
findings.source_contract: Baseline packages/ts-analyzer/src/analyze.ts:411-419 throws SOURCE_SNAPSHOT_REQUIRED when qualified-static-v1 has no compilerInputs; issue 365 section 2.2 includes captured inputs and required admissions/refusals in the frozen denominator.
findings.evidence: Source trace only. No candidate or oracle execution performed by this reviewer.
findings.coordination: Parent notified and independently preparing a development reproduction/correction. This report does not validate that later correction.

findings.title: Late named-configuration reasons do not refuse ordinary JavaScript in the private consumer path
findings.mechanism: The named_reasons post-pass applies to qualified subjects and JavaScript subjects. It appends SOURCE_NAMED_CONFIGURATION_UNSUPPORTED, but changes analyzed to unsupported only when qualified=true. With qualified=false, retained=true, one otherwise supported JavaScript module and an unconsumed tsconfig.build.json, the subject remains analyzed despite this refusal reason. batch::build then emits complete coverage and terminal=complete, and Receiver does not reject diagnostics on an analyzed batch. This bypasses the private refusal applied to other JavaScript reasons by inspect_subject.
findings.source_contract: Candidate main.rs:752 treats ordinary JavaScript reasons as unsupported; the parent clarified that this private controlled-refusal boundary intentionally prevents ownership on such reasons. This finding concerns that internal admission inconsistency, not equivalence of its enum spelling to the baseline source-analysis ledger.

observations_not_findings.topic: Ordinary JavaScript analyzed/partial versus private controlled refusal
observations_not_findings.detail: The baseline source sidecar keeps analysisOutcome=analyzed with partial capability profiles when JavaScript reasons exist.
